country.pick: Which country is {label} the capital of?
country.match: Match each capital to its country.
country.reverse: Which of these is the capital of {value}?

rows.label: London
rows.description: capital and largest city of England and the United Kingdom
rows.hook: is home to Big Ben, Tower Bridge and a famous river called the Thames

rows.label: Washington, D.C.
rows.description: capital city of the United States of America
rows.hook: is home to the White House, the Lincoln Memorial and a long grassy National Mall

rows.label: Berlin
rows.description: federated state, capital and largest city of Germany
rows.hook: was once split in two by a concrete wall that fell as the Cold War wound down

rows.label: Paris
rows.description: capital and most populous city in France
rows.hook: is home to an iron lattice tower and the museum that holds the Mona Lisa

rows.label: Tokyo
rows.description: capital and largest city of Japan
rows.hook: is home to the Shibuya scramble crossing, one of the busiest in the world

rows.label: Rome
rows.description: capital and largest city of Italy
rows.hook: is home to the Colosseum and the Trevi Fountain

rows.label: Prague
rows.description: capital city of the Czech Republic
rows.hook: is nicknamed the City of a Hundred Spires and has a famous astronomical clock

rows.label: Jakarta
rows.description: capital and largest city of Indonesia
rows.hook: is a huge, sinking megacity on the island of Java

rows.label: Beijing
rows.hook: is home to the Forbidden City and has hosted both summer and winter Olympics

rows.label: Moscow
rows.description: capital and most populous city of Russia
rows.hook: is home to the Kremlin and a huge square with an onion-domed cathedral

rows.label: Vienna
rows.description: capital of and state in Austria
rows.hook: is famed for Mozart, waltzes and a chocolate cake called the Sachertorte

rows.label: Budapest
rows.description: capital and largest city of Hungary
rows.hook: is split by the Danube and famous for its thermal baths and grand riverside parliament

rows.label: Athens
rows.description: capital and largest city of Greece
rows.hook: is overlooked by the Acropolis and the Parthenon

rows.label: Dublin
rows.description: capital and largest city of Ireland
rows.hook: is home to the Guinness brewery and the Temple Bar district

rows.label: Madrid
rows.hook: is home to the Prado museum, the Royal Palace and the Retiro park

rows.label: Bangkok
rows.hook: is famous for floating markets, tuk-tuks and glittering Buddhist temples

rows.label: Baku
rows.hook: sits on the Caspian Sea and is known for its three flame-shaped skyscrapers

rows.label: Damascus
rows.description: capital and largest city of Syria
rows.hook: is often called one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world

rows.label: Kuala Lumpur
rows.description: federal territory and capital city of Malaysia
rows.hook: is home to the Petronas Twin Towers

rows.label: Ottawa
rows.hook: is home to a canal that turns into a giant skating rink in winter

rows.label: Seoul
rows.description: capital and largest city of South Korea
rows.hook: is a K-pop hub built around the Han River

rows.label: Buenos Aires
rows.description: capital and largest city of Argentina
rows.hook: is considered the birthplace of the tango

rows.label: Warsaw
rows.description: capital and largest city of Poland
rows.hook: was rebuilt almost entirely from ruins after the Second World War and has a mermaid emblem

rows.label: Lisbon
rows.description: municipality and capital city of Portugal
rows.hook: is a hilly port city known for yellow trams and custard tarts

rows.label: Reykjavík
rows.description: capital and largest city in Iceland
rows.hook: is the northernmost capital of a sovereign state in the world

rows.label: Riyadh
rows.description: capital and largest city of Saudi Arabia
rows.hook: is a desert metropolis with a skyscraper topped by a giant bottle-opener-shaped gap

rows.label: Stockholm
rows.description: capital and largest city of Sweden
rows.hook: is spread across islands and hosts the Nobel Prize banquet each winter

rows.label: Canberra
rows.hook: was purpose-built as a compromise between two rival big cities

rows.label: Belgrade
rows.description: capital and largest city of Serbia
rows.hook: sits where the Sava river meets the Danube

rows.label: Bratislava
rows.hook: lies on the Danube and borders two other nations, unusual for a capital

rows.label: Cairo
rows.hook: is the gateway to the Giza pyramids and the Sphinx

rows.label: New Delhi
rows.hook: is a planned imperial capital with wide boulevards and a grand war memorial arch

rows.label: Ljubljana
rows.hook: is known for its Dragon Bridge and a castle above the old town

rows.label: Sarajevo
rows.description: capital city of Bosnia and Herzegovina
rows.hook: hosted a Winter Olympics and mixes Ottoman bazaars with grand Habsburg architecture

rows.label: Abu Dhabi
rows.description: capital city of the United Arab Emirates
rows.hook: is home to a huge white grand mosque and the Ferrari World theme park

rows.label: Kinshasa
rows.description: capital and the largest city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo having the status of a province
rows.hook: faces another national capital directly across a wide river

rows.label: Manila
rows.hook: is a crowded port city famous for jeepney buses and the walled district of Intramuros

rows.label: Ulaanbaatar
rows.description: capital and largest city of Mongolia
rows.hook: is often called the coldest capital city on Earth

rows.label: Kathmandu
rows.hook: is a valley city of temples and stupas, and the gateway to Mount Everest treks

rows.label: Oslo
rows.hook: hosts the Nobel Peace Prize ceremony and has a ski jump overlooking the city

rows.label: Tbilisi
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Georgia (country)
rows.hook: is known for sulfur baths and old houses with carved wooden balconies

rows.label: Addis Ababa
rows.hook: is the seat of the African Union and sits high in the mountains

rows.label: Baghdad
rows.hook: was the glittering centre of the Islamic Golden Age

rows.label: Kyiv
rows.description: capital and largest city of Ukraine
rows.hook: is known for golden-domed monasteries above the Dnieper river

rows.label: Dhaka
rows.description: capital and largest city of Bangladesh
rows.hook: is nicknamed the city of rickshaws

rows.label: Helsinki
rows.description: capital and most populous city of Finland
rows.hook: is a Baltic port city known for saunas, design and a white cathedral on a hill

rows.label: Tashkent
rows.hook: is a Silk Road city known for a metro with palace-like stations

rows.label: Yerevan
rows.description: capital and largest city of Armenia
rows.hook: is nicknamed the Pink City and has views of Mount Ararat

rows.label: Bucharest
rows.description: capital and largest city of Romania
rows.hook: is home to a colossal palace that is among the heaviest buildings in the world

rows.label: Tehran
rows.hook: sits at the foot of the snowy Alborz mountains

rows.label: Astana
rows.hook: is a futuristic planned capital with a giant glass tent-shaped shopping centre

rows.label: Hanoi
rows.hook: is known for its Old Quarter, motorbike traffic and egg coffee

rows.label: Minsk
rows.description: capital and largest city of Belarus
rows.hook: is a wide-avenue Soviet-planned city rebuilt after the Second World War

rows.label: Bogotá
rows.hook: is a high-altitude Andean city famous for its Gold Museum

rows.label: Nairobi
rows.hook: has a national park with lions and giraffes right beside its skyscrapers

rows.label: Pyongyang
rows.hook: is known for a towering pyramid-shaped hotel that stood unfinished for decades

rows.label: Tallinn
rows.description: capital and most populous city of Estonia
rows.hook: has a remarkably preserved medieval old town and a busy tech start-up scene

rows.label: Beirut
rows.description: capital and largest city of Lebanon
rows.hook: was once nicknamed the Paris of the Middle East

rows.label: Brasília
rows.hook: was built from scratch in the shape of an airplane

rows.label: Bishkek
rows.hook: sits beneath the snowy Tian Shan mountains

rows.label: Sofia
rows.hook: sits beneath a mountain called Vitosha and is among Europe's oldest capitals

rows.label: Ankara
rows.hook: took over from Istanbul as seat of government and lent its name to a long-haired goat breed

rows.label: Wellington
rows.description: capital city of New Zealand; urban area of the cities of Wellington, Lower Hutt, Upper Hutt, and Porirua
rows.hook: is a windy harbour capital at the foot of the North Island

rows.label: Kabul
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Afghanistan
rows.hook: sits in a high mountain valley along ancient Silk Road routes

rows.label: Vilnius
rows.description: capital and largest city of Lithuania
rows.hook: has a huge baroque old town and a bohemian district that declared itself a mock republic

rows.label: Santiago
rows.hook: sits in a valley beneath the snowy Andes

rows.label: Riga
rows.description: capital and largest city of Latvia
rows.hook: is famed for having one of the world's largest collections of Art Nouveau buildings

rows.label: Zagreb
rows.hook: is a capital whose soldiers are credited with inspiring the necktie

rows.label: Islamabad
rows.hook: is a planned city built from scratch to replace Karachi as the seat of government

rows.label: Lima
rows.description: capital and largest city of Peru
rows.hook: is a Pacific coast capital and a South American food hotspot famed for ceviche

rows.label: Kampala
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Uganda
rows.hook: is a hilly city on the shore of Lake Victoria, said to be built on seven hills

rows.label: Nassau
rows.description: capital and largest city of the Bahamas
rows.hook: is a Caribbean port city that was once a haven for pirates

rows.label: Skopje
rows.hook: is the birthplace of Mother Teresa and is lined with hundreds of statues

rows.label: Algiers
rows.hook: is a Mediterranean capital with a hillside old quarter called the Casbah

rows.label: Mogadishu
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Somalia
rows.hook: is an ancient Indian Ocean port on the Horn of Africa

rows.label: Doha
rows.hook: is a Gulf capital that hosted a men's soccer World Cup played in winter

rows.label: Amman
rows.hook: sits on hills near ancient Roman ruins, a short drive from Petra and the Dead Sea

rows.label: Phnom Penh
rows.hook: sits where the Mekong and Tonle Sap rivers meet

rows.label: Nicosia
rows.hook: is the last European capital still split by a buffer zone

rows.label: Valletta
rows.hook: is a fortified harbour city built by knights and is one of Europe's smallest capitals

rows.label: Port Moresby
rows.hook: is a harbour city on the coast of the world's second-largest island

rows.label: Harare
rows.description: capital and largest city of Zimbabwe
rows.hook: is a high-altitude capital known for its jacaranda-lined streets

rows.label: Santo Domingo
rows.hook: is the oldest European-founded city in the Americas

rows.label: Bern
rows.description: city in Switzerland, capital of the canton of Bern and de facto capital of Switzerland
rows.hook: is a medieval city with arcaded streets, a famous clock tower and a bear on its coat of arms

rows.label: Montevideo
rows.description: capital and largest city of Uruguay
rows.hook: sits on the north shore of the wide Rio de la Plata estuary

rows.label: Colombo
rows.description: largest city and de facto capital of Sri Lanka
rows.hook: is the commercial port city of an island once known as Ceylon

rows.label: Chișinău
rows.hook: is a capital surrounded by vineyards and famed for its huge underground wine cellars

rows.label: Havana
rows.description: capital and largest city of Cuba
rows.hook: is famed for classic 1950s American cars and a seaside promenade called the Malecon

rows.label: La Paz
rows.description: capital city and seat of government of Bolivia
rows.hook: is the highest seat of government in the world, ringed by mountains and served by cable cars

rows.label: Tirana
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Albania
rows.hook: is known for brightly painted apartment blocks and a pyramid-shaped landmark

rows.label: Abuja
rows.hook: is a planned capital built to replace Lagos and overlooked by a huge rock called Aso Rock

rows.label: Muscat
rows.hook: is a Gulf port capital wedged between mountains and sea, with a grand mosque and old forts

rows.label: Khartoum
rows.hook: sits where the Blue Nile and the White Nile join

rows.label: Ouagadougou
rows.hook: hosts Africa's biggest film festival, FESPACO

rows.label: Quito
rows.hook: is one of the highest capitals in the world, sitting close to the equator

rows.label: Ashgabat
rows.hook: is a desert capital covered in gleaming white marble buildings

rows.label: Accra
rows.hook: is a Gulf of Guinea coastal capital in a land once called the Gold Coast

rows.label: Brussels
rows.description: municipality in the Brussels-Capital Region and capital of Belgium
rows.hook: hosts the main institutions of the European Union and is famed for waffles and chocolate

rows.label: Tripoli
rows.hook: is a Mediterranean port with an old medina and a Roman triumphal arch

rows.label: Tunis
rows.hook: sits near the ruins of ancient Carthage and has a UNESCO-listed medina

rows.label: Dakar
rows.description: capital and the largest city of Senegal
rows.hook: sits on the Cape Verde peninsula at the westernmost point of mainland Africa

rows.label: Rabat
rows.hook: is an Atlantic coast capital with an unfinished minaret known as the Hassan Tower

rows.label: Windhoek
rows.description: capital of the Republic of Namibia
rows.hook: is a tidy highland capital with German colonial-style buildings

rows.label: Naypyidaw
rows.hook: is a huge purpose-built capital with wide, nearly empty highways

rows.label: Caracas
rows.description: capital and largest city of Venezuela
rows.hook: sits in a valley below the Avila mountain, near the Caribbean coast

rows.label: Podgorica
rows.hook: is a small Balkan capital at the meeting of the Moraca and Ribnica rivers

rows.label: Kingston
rows.hook: is a Caribbean port city at the heart of reggae music

rows.label: Luanda
rows.hook: is an Atlantic port on the southwest coast of Africa, once a Portuguese trading post

rows.label: Antananarivo
rows.description: capital and largest city of Madagascar
rows.hook: is a hilltop capital on the world's fourth-largest island, home of lemurs

rows.label: Monrovia
rows.hook: was named for a US president and settled by freed American slaves

rows.label: Malé
rows.hook: is a tiny, crowded island capital in the Indian Ocean atolls

rows.label: Port-au-Prince
rows.hook: is a bay-side capital on the western half of the island of Hispaniola

rows.label: Vientiane
rows.hook: is a sleepy riverside capital on the Mekong, facing its neighbour across the water

rows.label: Dushanbe
rows.hook: is a mountain-ringed capital whose name means Monday

rows.label: Georgetown
rows.hook: is a capital of wooden colonial buildings on South America's northern coast

rows.label: Tegucigalpa
rows.description: capital and largest city of Honduras
rows.hook: is a hilly Central American capital in a mountain valley

rows.label: Asunción
rows.hook: is a riverside capital and one of the oldest cities in South America

rows.label: Brazzaville
rows.description: capital of the Republic of the Congo
rows.hook: faces another capital across a river, the closest pair of capitals in the world outside Europe

rows.label: Kigali
rows.description: province-level city, capital and largest city of Rwanda
rows.hook: is a famously clean, hilly capital in the land of a thousand hills

rows.label: San Salvador
rows.hook: sits in a valley beneath a volcano in Central America's smallest country

rows.label: Port of Spain
rows.hook: hosts a huge pre-Lenten carnival famed for steelpan music and calypso

rows.label: San José
rows.hook: sits in a highland valley of a nation famed for ecotourism and coffee

rows.label: Nouakchott
rows.hook: grew from a desert village into a sprawling capital where the Sahara meets the Atlantic

rows.label: Niamey
rows.hook: lies on a great West African river in a landlocked Sahel nation

rows.label: Freetown
rows.hook: was settled as a haven for formerly enslaved people returning from Britain and North America

rows.label: Gaborone
rows.hook: is the capital of a southern African nation famed for diamonds and the Okavango Delta

rows.label: Bamako
rows.hook: sits on the Niger River and is a West African hub of music, in the land of Timbuktu

rows.label: Paramaribo
rows.hook: has a UNESCO-listed historic centre of Dutch colonial wooden buildings in South America

rows.label: Dodoma
rows.hook: was chosen as the official seat of government even though a bigger coastal city stays larger

rows.label: Juba
rows.description: capital of the Republic of South Sudan
rows.hook: is the capital of the world's newest country, on the banks of the White Nile

rows.label: Maputo
rows.description: capital and chief port of Mozambique
rows.hook: is an Indian Ocean port once known by the colonial name Lourenço Marques

rows.label: Bangui
rows.description: capital city of the Central African Republic
rows.hook: stands on the north bank of the Ubangi River, a border river in the heart of Africa

rows.label: Bandar Seri Begawan
rows.description: capital and largest city of Brunei

rows.label: N'Djamena
rows.description: capital and largest city of Chad
rows.hook: lies where the Chari and Logone rivers meet, near a shrinking lake in the Sahel

rows.label: Manama
rows.hook: is a Persian Gulf island capital known for pearling history and Formula One racing

rows.label: Port Louis
rows.hook: is a harbour capital on an Indian Ocean island that was home to the extinct dodo

rows.label: Conakry
rows.hook: sits on a narrow peninsula jutting into the Atlantic on West Africa's coast
